The [[Liga Super]] champions for 2015 was [[Johor Darul Ta'zim F.C.|Johor Darul Ta'zim]]. ==Team changes== The following teams have changed division. {{col-begin|width=auto}} {{col-break}} ===To Malaysia Super League=== '''Promoted from [[2014 Malaysia Premier League|Premier League]]''' * [[PDRM FA|PDRM]] * [[Felda United F.C.|Felda United]] {{col-break|gap=3em}} ===From Malaysia Super League=== '''Relegated to [[2015 Malaysia Premier League|Premier League]]''' * [[T–Team F.C.|T–Team]] * [[PKNS F.C.|PKNS]] {{col-end}} ==Teams== A total of 12 teams compete in the 2015 season which includes the top 10 teams that participated in the [[2014 Liga Super|2014 season]] and champions and runners-up of the [[2014 Liga Premier]]. [[T-Team F.C.|T-Team]] and [[PKNS F.C.|PKNS]] were relegated at the end of the [[2014 Liga Super]] season after finishing in the bottom place of the league table.
